outcome: mother to child transmission (MTCT) of HIV-1 infection
cohort: The review summarizes findings from published studies on host factors and viral genetics impacting mother-to-child transmission of HIV in African populations.
finding: Specific host genes (CCR2-64I, HLA class I) and breast milk constituents were associated with protection against mother-to-child HIV transmission, while SDF1-3'A showed no effect.
